policy: Only redistributable material. No third-party dataset has been copied into this folder; no network download was made to build it.

sources.name: Project-authored medical vocabulary
sources.scope: all domain folders (*_core.txt, cells_glia_myelin.txt, brain_structures.txt, synapse_transmission.txt, stains_cytology.txt, drugs_generic.txt, ...)
sources.origin: written for this project by the maintainers / assistant from general medical-education knowledge (standard terms, eponyms, generic drug names, Latin plurals); reviewed line by line, not scraped
sources.notes: Cue words are plain context hints written by hand; confusables are generic ASR mix-ups (never lecture-specific replacement rules).

sources.name: Starter vocabulary shipped since 0.1 (medical_terms/*.txt)
sources.scope: <domain>/baseline.txt in anatomy, biochemistry, internal_medicine, histology, molecular_biology, neuroscience, pathology, pharmacology, physiology
sources.origin: the project's own starter lists, imported unchanged (lines for Turkish-only runs removed)

sources.name: Generic (non-proprietary) drug names
sources.origin: international non-proprietary names (INN) are public names; brand names appear only as accepted alternative spellings
sources.license: names are not copyrightable; list compiled by hand

extension.how: add a line to any medical_vocab/<domain>/*.txt, or a new folder with an optional _domain.json; run scripts/lint_medical_vocab.py
extension.user_terms: Settings > Medical Vocabulary > Add Terms (stored per user, never written into this folder)

candidate_bulk_sources.name: MeSH (NLM)
candidate_bulk_sources.license: public domain (U.S. government work); attribution requested
